title: Filipino Beef Bistek
description: A classic Filipino dish made with marinated beef, onions, and garlic, grilled to perfection. This recipe is a staple in many Filipino households, and is sure to become a favorite in yours.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine beef, onion, and garlic. Pour in bistek and mix until the beef is well coated.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Remove the beef from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Grill the beef for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
Let the beef rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Serve the beef with the onions and garlic from the marinade, and enjoy!
